Counterburst Step.name: Counterburst Step
Counterburst Step.description: The user meets an incoming attack with a small, exact release of the Quirk at the instant of impact: a burst, a flare, a hardened patch or a surge of strength. The attack is knocked aside without harm, including a thrown object or a shot, and an attacker within reach takes the Quirk's own damage type from the same release (bludgeoning from a strengthened or hardened body). A blast that fills the area is too big to turn. Strain: moderate.
